title: Hunters and the infernal
summary: What the imbued face once the Fallen walk the world.

claims.text: Rebel angels who sided with humanity lost their war with Heaven and were cast into the Abyss; for ages only the odd spirit got out, called up by a reckless sorcerer or cultist striking a pact.
Now the gates of Hell have cracked and a horde has come up to Earth, and while hunters know no more than anyone else about what devils truly are, they can see them for what they are.
Hunters bring no better weapons or lore against demons than against other creatures, yet where vampires and walking corpses threatened lives, these beings may threaten Creation itself.
What hunters learn of demons comes from confused imbued and from the deceivers themselves, so every so-called revelation about their origins and aims is doubtful.

title: Faces demons show hunters
summary: The different ways the returned Fallen meet the imbued.

claims.text: Some demons come back into human lives as lost and bewildered as any newly chosen hunter, which can stir sympathy in the imbued.
Others claim to want to do good for humanity now that they have a second chance, and hunters cannot tell whether such kindness is real or a lie.
Still others work their way deep into modern life, playing on weakness and fear to draw people into pacts for rewards in this life.
